description: Edit the project's SHOT DIRECTORS — the author-editable prompt system a shot's render prompt is written with. Each production type (2d / 3d-pixar / live-action) has ONE director in use; a director carries `instructions` (the brief the shot-list skills follow when writing a shot's prompt) and a `promptForm` that decides the SHAPE of every shot: "paragraph" (the whole prompt goes in the single `prompt` field, whatever internal structure the director asks for) or "blocks" (the shot carries `promptBlocks` under the contract's fixed keys and the server composes `prompt` from them). Read the current ones with get_shot_director first. Four things this call can do, decided by which fields you send: ACTIVATE an existing director for a production type (`id` + `activate: true`); EDIT one in place (`id` + `instructions`/`name`/`promptForm`); save a NEW VERSION derived from one (`id` + `instructions` + `newVersion: true` — the original is left untouched and the new version becomes active unless you pass `activate: false`); RESET an edited built-in back to its shipped text (`id` + `reset: true`). `delete: true` removes an author-created version (a built-in can only be reset, never deleted). Changing a director changes how the NEXT shots are written — it never rewrites shots that already exist. Returns the full director list, the active director per production type, and the one this project is writing with right now.

id.description: The director to act on, from get_shot_director (e.g. "director-seedance"). Required for activate / edit / newVersion / reset / delete. Omit it ONLY to create a director from scratch, in which case `name` and `instructions` are required.

productionType.description: Which production type this director belongs to (and, with `activate`, which one it becomes the director FOR). Defaults to the project's current production type from get_world.

name.description: Display name, e.g. "Seedance director — handheld doc". Required when creating a director with no `id`.

promptForm.description: WHERE this director's render prompt is stored, which decides the shape of every shot you write. "paragraph" = the whole prompt goes in the single `prompt` field — one vivid paragraph for the 2D/3D directors, or the labelled single-shot document the Seedance 2.0 Pro director specifies. "blocks" = the prompt is sent as `promptBlocks`, whose keys are fixed by the shot contract, and the server composes `prompt` from them; only a director written to those exact keys can use this form. Defaults to the edited director's current form, or "paragraph" for a new one.

instructions.description: The director's prompt system: the full brief a writer follows to produce one shot's render prompt (what to include, what to measure, what to never write). This is what the shot-list skills read back and obey, so write it as instructions to the writer, not as a description of them. Sending it REPLACES the whole text — read the current one with get_shot_director and edit from that rather than writing a shorter one from memory.

newVersion.description: Save `instructions` as a NEW director derived from `id` instead of editing it in place. The original stays exactly as it was, and the new version becomes the active one for its production type unless you pass `activate: false`. Use it when the author wants to try a variant without losing the current one.

activate.description: Make this director the one used for `productionType`. Defaults to true when creating or saving a new version, false when merely editing text in place.

reset.description: Drop the author's edits to a BUILT-IN director and restore its shipped text. Ignored for author-created directors (there is no shipped text to go back to).

delete.description: Delete an author-created director. A built-in can never be deleted (use `reset`). If it was active, its production type falls back to the built-in director.
